opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, rude speaking. can I help?
opening.comment: The greeting gives the company name but the agent's name is garbled as 'rude speaking'; state your real name clearly.

verification.quote: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
verification.comment: The agent changed the order without first confirming the caller's full name plus order number or account postcode; always verify before changing order data.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi root, I need to change the delivery address on my order. I've just moved and I'm really stressed about this, it's urgent.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the address change request and the order number, but did not acknowledge the caller's stated stress or urgency.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will go to the new address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the agent wrongly promised the change would work after dispatch; the delivery timeline quoted was also not clearly accurate.

process_compliance.quote: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or permission steps were needed, but the agent failed to follow the policy that address changes are only possible before dispatch, and did not escalate the post-dispatch case.

communication.quote: Fine. Give me the new address.
communication.comment: The agent was curt and dismissive toward a stressed, urgent caller and did not acknowledge their frustration; use a warmer, more polite tone.

closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else but did not clearly confirm next steps or the delivery outcome, and ended abruptly; summarise what happens next before closing.
